content.short: Blinks Labs is an automation layer running event-triggered DeFi strategies.
content.description: Blinks Labs executes DeFi strategies when specified on-chain events occur, removing the need for a user to watch for the trigger themselves. Event-driven automation is what turns a conditional intention into something that actually happens at three in the morning.
content.meta: DeFi strategies that fire automatically when a specified onchain event occurs.
